sloka: स पित्रा च परित्यक्तः सुरैश्च समहर्षिभिः ।त्रिल्लोकान् संपरिक्रम्य त्रातारं नाधिगच्छति ।। ५.६७.१४ ।।।।
transliteration: sa pitrā ca parityaktaḥ suraiśca samaharṣibhiḥ ।trillokān saṁparikramya trātāraṁ nādhigacchati ।। 5.67.14 ।।।।

translations.english: 'He was abandoned by his father, even by great sages and gods. Then he went round the three worlds but could not find a saviour.
